binding: All six unchanged actual Node endpoint cases are read from real Neo files against actual Lance rows. Only original fixture agent/user/workspace and endpoint IDs are mapped; foreign or mismatching claims remain unchanged.
differences: Native private endpoints require the original user/workspace, including when a matching-agent foreign actual row exists.
Actual same-table live row tuples must match both serialized endpoint claims; missing, rebound, expired or invalid-at rows contribute no edges.
Ambiguous duplicate keys, non-scalar graph fields and non-finite/out-of-range strengths are not projected. No numeric/string coercion or opaque Unicode replacement.
Latest visible metadata is limited to 5000 records; at most 400 records and 200 distinct same-table endpoints are inspected.
An explicitly configured native source is used after model callbacks; failures never fall back to in-memory edges.
boundaries: Historical Node goldens and the explicit preauthorized legacy edge input are unchanged.
No ProcessEngine activation, schema/frozen trait change, external-writer CAS or atomic cross-store snapshot is claimed.
